description: This file implements a thread pool and related synchronization mechanisms for the torch::lazy namespace, including scheduling and completion handling for asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads for executing scheduled tasks.

classes.name: Completion
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation that can be waited upon for completion.

classes.name: Completion::Data
classes.description: Holds the state and synchronization primitives for a Completion object.

methods.name: GetIoThreadPool
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the thread pool used for IO operations.

methods.name: Completion::Data::Wait
methods.description: Blocks until the associated asynchronous operation completes.

methods.name: Completion::Data::GetCompleter
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that executes a closure and signals completion.

methods.name: Completion::Data::Complete
methods.description: Marks the operation as complete and stores any exception that occurred.

methods.name: Completion::Completion
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Completion object with shared data.

methods.name: Completion::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the completion of the associated asynchronous task.

methods.name: ScheduleIoClosure
methods.description: Schedules a closure to run asynchronously on the IO thread pool.

methods.name: ScheduleIoClosureWithCompletion
methods.description: Schedules a closure and returns a Completion object to wait for its completion.
